This notebook brings together the TWFE results from `Stage1.ipynb` and the Callaway & Sant'Anna results from `Stage2.ipynb`, and builds the overall comparison tables. It reads the result files saved in `Output/` by the two previous notebooks.

- Task 1 compares the main results: TWFE on the full sample, TWFE on the switcher-excluded sample, and Callaway & Sant'Anna (the one-year lagged pill)

- Task 2 compares the same three columns across the timing checks, in three panels: the one-year lagged pill (main results), the one-year lagged pill on the same rows as the current-year pill, and the current-year pill

- Task 3 compares Callaway & Sant'Anna without and with an anticipation of one year

Run order: `Data_Process.ipynb` -\> `Stage1.ipynb` -\> `Stage2.ipynb` -\> `Stage3.ipynb`.

## Libraries & Configurations

```{r}
# Clear the workspace
rm(list = ls())
```

```{r}
# Directories for data and output
DIR_DATA_PROC <- "Data_Processed/"
DIR_OUT       <- "Output/"
dir.create(DIR_OUT, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
```

```{r}
# Library packages
library(tidyverse)
```

## Load Results

```{r}
# Load the results saved by Stage1.ipynb and Stage2.ipynb
results_s1t1_twfe_origin <- read.csv(paste0(DIR_OUT, "results_s1t1_twfe_origin.csv"))   # TWFE, full sample (Stage 1)
results_s1t4_twfe_ns     <- read.csv(paste0(DIR_OUT, "results_s1t4_twfe_ns.csv"))       # TWFE, switcher-excluded sample (Stage 1)
results_s2t1_cs          <- read.csv(paste0(DIR_OUT, "results_s2t1_cs.csv"))            # Callaway & Sant'Anna, switcher-excluded sample (Stage 2)

# Timing checks
results_s1t5a_twfe_cp    <- read.csv(paste0(DIR_OUT, "results_s1t5a_twfe_cp.csv"))      # TWFE, current-year pill, full sample (Stage 1)
results_s1t5b_twfe_cpns  <- read.csv(paste0(DIR_OUT, "results_s1t5b_twfe_cpns.csv"))    # TWFE, current-year pill, switcher-excluded sample (Stage 1)
results_s1t5c_twfe_lg    <- read.csv(paste0(DIR_OUT, "results_s1t5c_twfe_lg.csv"))      # TWFE, lagged pill on the same rows, full sample (Stage 1)
results_s1t5d_twfe_lgns  <- read.csv(paste0(DIR_OUT, "results_s1t5d_twfe_lgns.csv"))    # TWFE, lagged pill on the same rows, switcher-excluded sample (Stage 1)
results_s2t3a_cs_cp      <- read.csv(paste0(DIR_OUT, "results_s2t3a_cs_cp.csv"))        # Callaway & Sant'Anna, current-year pill, switcher-excluded sample (Stage 2)
results_s2t3b_cs_ant     <- read.csv(paste0(DIR_OUT, "results_s2t3b_cs_ant.csv"))       # Callaway & Sant'Anna, one-year lag with anticipation = 1, switcher-excluded sample (Stage 2)
results_s2t3c_cs_lg      <- read.csv(paste0(DIR_OUT, "results_s2t3c_cs_lg.csv"))        # Callaway & Sant'Anna, lagged pill on the same rows, switcher-excluded sample (Stage 2)
```

## Comparison of Results

### (1) Stage 3 Task 1: Overall Comparison

```{r}
# Check that every comparison row has all its estimates (a failed join would leave NA)
check_missing <- function(df, cols) {
  cat("Rows:", nrow(df), "| rows with a missing estimate:", sum(!complete.cases(df[, cols])), "\n")
}

# Build overall comparison table
results_s3t1_overall_comparison <- results_s1t1_twfe_origin |>
  filter(spec == "baseline_TWFE") |>
  select(age_group, outcome, TWFE_full_coef = coef, TWFE_full_se = se, TWFE_full_pvalue = p_value) |>
  left_join(
    results_s1t4_twfe_ns |>
      filter(spec == "baseline_TWFE") |>
      select(age_group, outcome, TWFE_restricted_coef = coef, TWFE_restricted_se = se, TWFE_restricted_pvalue = p_value),
    by = c("age_group", "outcome")
  ) |>
  left_join(
    results_s2t1_cs |>
      filter(spec == "baseline") |>
      select(age_group, outcome, CS_restricted_coef = coef, CS_restricted_se = se, CS_restricted_pvalue = p_value),
    by = c("age_group", "outcome")
  )

write.csv(results_s3t1_overall_comparison, paste0(DIR_OUT, "results_s3t1_overall_comparison.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

cat("\n===== Stage 3 Task 1: Comparison of Results =====\n")
check_missing(results_s3t1_overall_comparison, c("TWFE_full_coef", "TWFE_restricted_coef", "CS_restricted_coef"))
results_s3t1_overall_comparison
```

```{r}
# Same three-way comparison for each of the four specifications (long format: one row per group x specification)
spec_labels <- c(
  baseline_TWFE           = "baseline",
  TWFE_with_trends        = "with_trends",
  TWFE_with_covariates    = "with_covariates",
  baseline_popln_weighted = "popln_weighted"
)

pick <- function(df, prefix) {
  df |>
    mutate(spec = coalesce(spec_labels[spec], spec)) |>
    select(age_group, outcome, spec, coef, se, p_value, n_municipal) |>
    rename_with(~ paste0(prefix, "_", .x), c(coef, se, p_value, n_municipal))
}

results_s3t1_overall_comparison_allspecs <- pick(results_s1t1_twfe_origin, "TWFE_full") |>
  left_join(pick(results_s1t4_twfe_ns, "TWFE_restricted"), by = c("age_group", "outcome", "spec")) |>
  left_join(pick(results_s2t1_cs,      "CS_restricted"),   by = c("age_group", "outcome", "spec")) |>
  arrange(factor(spec, levels = unname(spec_labels)), age_group, outcome)

write.csv(results_s3t1_overall_comparison_allspecs, paste0(DIR_OUT, "results_s3t1_overall_comparison_allspecs.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

cat("\n===== Stage 3 Task 1: Comparison of Results, All Four Specifications =====\n")
check_missing(results_s3t1_overall_comparison_allspecs, c("TWFE_full_coef", "TWFE_restricted_coef", "CS_restricted_coef"))
results_s3t1_overall_comparison_allspecs
```

### (2) Stage 3 Task 2: Comparison of the Timing Checks

```{r}
# Three panels, each with the same three columns (TWFE on the full sample, TWFE on the switcher-excluded sample, Callaway & Sant'Anna)
#   Panel A: the one-year lagged pill, 2006-2011 (main results, Task 1)
#   Panel B: the one-year lagged pill, on the same rows as Panel C (2006-2010)
#   Panel C: the current-year pill (2006-2010)
# spec_labels and pick() are defined in Task 1 above (long format: one row per panel x group x specification)
build_panel <- function(twfe_full, twfe_restricted, cs, label) {
  pick(twfe_full, "TWFE_full") |>
    left_join(pick(twfe_restricted, "TWFE_restricted"), by = c("age_group", "outcome", "spec")) |>
    left_join(pick(cs,              "CS_restricted"),   by = c("age_group", "outcome", "spec")) |>
    mutate(panel = label, .before = 1)
}

results_s3t2_timing_comparison <- bind_rows(
  build_panel(results_s1t1_twfe_origin, results_s1t4_twfe_ns,    results_s2t1_cs,     "A. Lagged pill, 2006-2011"),
  build_panel(results_s1t5c_twfe_lg,    results_s1t5d_twfe_lgns, results_s2t3c_cs_lg, "B. Lagged pill, same rows as C, 2006-2010"),
  build_panel(results_s1t5a_twfe_cp,    results_s1t5b_twfe_cpns, results_s2t3a_cs_cp, "C. Current pill, 2006-2010")
) |>
  arrange(factor(spec, levels = unname(spec_labels)), age_group, outcome, panel)

write.csv(results_s3t2_timing_comparison, paste0(DIR_OUT, "results_s3t2_timing_comparison.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

cat("\n===== Stage 3 Task 2: Comparison of the Timing Checks (3 Panels, All Four Specifications) =====\n")
check_missing(results_s3t2_timing_comparison, c("TWFE_full_coef", "TWFE_restricted_coef", "CS_restricted_coef"))
results_s3t2_timing_comparison
```

### (3) Stage 3 Task 3: Comparison with Anticipation of One Year

```{r}
# Callaway & Sant'Anna without (Task 1) and with (Stage 2 Task 3b) an anticipation of one year, on the same switcher-excluded sample
results_s3t3_anticipation_comparison <- pick(results_s2t1_cs, "CS_ant0") |>
  left_join(pick(results_s2t3b_cs_ant, "CS_ant1"), by = c("age_group", "outcome", "spec")) |>
  arrange(factor(spec, levels = unname(spec_labels)), age_group, outcome)

write.csv(results_s3t3_anticipation_comparison, paste0(DIR_OUT, "results_s3t3_anticipation_comparison.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

cat("\n===== Stage 3 Task 3: Callaway & Sant'Anna without and with Anticipation = 1 (All Four Specifications) =====\n")
check_missing(results_s3t3_anticipation_comparison, c("CS_ant0_coef", "CS_ant1_coef"))
results_s3t3_anticipation_comparison
```
